change_summary: Distinguish ordinary copyrighted or third-party sources from explicitly restricted material, and give Codex upload runs network-only permission without undeclared local writes.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill preserves provenance and applicable use terms while excluding only material whose explicit restriction or policy forbids the requested private Workspace retention or processing.

server_contract.note: The typed contract and compact MCP initialization expose the same third-party-material boundary without introducing a source-category classifier.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.31 with collaboration contract 2026-09-13.6; the session hook carries the same compact boundary.

workspace_cli.note: CLI upload commands and package bytes are unchanged; collaboration status consumes the server-owned 2026-09-13.6 freshness contract.

help_center.note: Localized Developer and MCP Help distinguish provenance and applicable-use handling from a blanket copyright veto.

package_setup.note: Package setup is unchanged; the bundled Skill, hook and shared contract carry the boundary.

harness_and_mainline.note: Codex upload runs now use a named read-only filesystem profile with a network allowlist; the failed J2T1 receipt remains immutable trigger evidence.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; external directory review and full independent Claude longitudinal acceptance remain separate evidence.

release_evidence.note: Focused guards cover disclosure wording, contract/package parity, MCP instruction budget and the Codex read-only upload profile; unchanged J2T1 plus restricted/local-only countercases remain the live gate.
